text.traditional: 芳草，妳也來逛百貨公司啊！
text.simplified: 芳草，你也来逛百货公司啊！
text.pinyin: Fāngcǎo, nǐ yě lái guàng bǎihuò gōngsī a!
text.english: Fangcao, you're shopping at the department store too!

text.traditional: 是啊！我下個月要參加朋友的婚禮，來買件合適的衣服。妳呢？怎麼也來了？
text.simplified: 是啊！我下个月要参加朋友的婚礼，来买件合适的衣服。你呢？怎么也来了？
text.pinyin: Shì a! Wǒ xià ge yuè yào cānjiā péngyǒu de hūnlǐ, lái mǎi jiàn héshì de yīfu. Nǐ ne? Zěnme yě lái le?
text.english: Yes! I'm attending a friend's wedding next month and came to buy a suitable outfit. What about you? How come you came too?

text.traditional: 這家百貨公司正在打折，我特地來買上衣。要不要一起逛逛？
text.simplified: 这家百货公司正在打折，我特地来买上衣。要不要一起逛逛？
text.pinyin: Zhè jiā bǎihuò gōngsī zhèngzài dǎzhé, wǒ tèdì lái mǎi shàngyī. Yào búyào yìqǐ guàngguang?
text.english: This department store is currently having a sale, so I specially came to buy a top. Want to browse together?

text.traditional: 好啊，順便請妳給我一些意見。我們先上二樓看看，那裡有各式各樣的衣服、皮帶、皮鞋。如果有時間，我也想買一雙球鞋給我先生。
text.simplified: 好啊，顺便请你给我一些意见。我们先上二楼看看，那里有各式各样的衣服、皮带、皮鞋。如果有时间，我也想买一双球鞋给我先生。
text.pinyin: Hǎo a, shùnbiàn qǐng nǐ gěi wǒ yìxiē yìjiàn. Wǒmen xiān shàng èr lóu kànkan, nàlǐ yǒu gèshìgèyàng de yīfu, pídài, píxié. Rúguǒ yǒu shíjiān, wǒ yě xiǎng mǎi yì shuāng qiúxié gěi wǒ xiānshēng.
text.english: Sure, and while we're at it, you can give me some advice. Let's go up to the second floor first to take a look; they have all kinds of clothes, belts, and leather shoes. If there is time, I also want to buy a pair of sneakers for my husband.

text.traditional: （她們到了二樓A專櫃）
text.simplified: （她们到了二楼A专柜）
text.pinyin: (Tāmen dào le èr lóu A zhuānguì)
text.english: (They reach Counter A on the second floor.)

text.traditional: 這個專櫃的衣服都不錯，模特兒身上那件深藍色的洋裝，設計得很有特色，看起來很適合參加婚禮。
text.simplified: 这个专柜的衣服都不错，模特儿身上那件深蓝色的洋装，设计得很有特色，看起来很适合参加婚礼。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge zhuānguì de yīfu dōu búcuò, mótèr shēnshàng nà jiàn shēn lánsè de yángzhuāng, shèjì de hěn yǒu tèsè, kànqǐlái hěn shìhé cānjiā hūnlǐ.
text.english: The clothes at this counter are all nice; that navy blue dress on the mannequin has a really distinctive design, and it looks perfect for a wedding.

text.traditional: 嗯，這套淺色的也很好看，妳都試穿一下吧！
text.simplified: 嗯，这套浅色的也很好看，你都试穿一下吧！
text.pinyin: Ēn, zhè tào qiǎnsè de yě hěn hǎokàn, nǐ dōu shìchuān yíxià ba!
text.english: Mm, this light-colored outfit looks nice too. Go ahead and try them both on!

text.traditional: （芳草先試穿了深藍色的洋裝後）
text.simplified: （芳草先试穿了深蓝色的洋装后）
text.pinyin: (Fāngcǎo xiān shìchuān le shēn lánsè de yángzhuāng hòu)
text.english: (After Fangcao tries on the navy dress)

text.traditional: 不錯喔！妳的個子高，穿起洋裝來挺好看的。
text.simplified: 不错喔！你的个子高，穿起洋装来挺好看的。
text.pinyin: Búcuò o! Nǐ de gèzi gāo, chuān qǐ yángzhuāng lái tǐng hǎo kàn de.
text.english: Not bad! You're tall, so you look quite nice wearing a dress.

text.traditional: 是挺好看的。不過，價錢有點兒貴，樣子也太正式了，恐怕平常沒什麼機會穿。我再試穿那件淺色的吧！
text.simplified: 是挺好看的。不过，价钱有点儿贵，样子也太正式了，恐怕平常没什么机会穿。我再试穿那件浅色的吧！
text.pinyin: Shì tǐng hǎo kàn de. Búguò, jiàqián yǒudiǎnr guì, yàngzi yě tài zhèngshì le, kǒngpà píngcháng méishénme jīhuì chuān. Wǒ zài shìchuān nà jiàn qiǎnsè de ba!
text.english: It does look quite nice. However, the price is a bit steep and the style is too formal; I'm afraid I wouldn't have much chance to wear it normally. Let me try on that light-colored one!

text.traditional: （芳草試穿了淺色的衣服後）
text.simplified: （芳草试穿了浅色的衣服后）
text.pinyin: (Fāngcǎo shìchuān le qiǎnsè de yīfu hòu)
text.english: (After Fangcao tries on the light-colored outfit)

text.traditional: 這件穿起來有點兒緊，而且比剛才那件還要貴。算了，去別家吧。
text.simplified: 这件穿起来有点儿紧，而且比刚才那件还要贵。算了，去别家吧。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiàn chuān qǐlái yǒudiǎnr jǐn, érqiě bǐ gāngcái nà jiàn háiyào guì. Suànle, qù bié jiā ba.
text.english: This one feels a bit tight, and it's even more expensive than the last one. Forget it, let's go somewhere else.

text.traditional: （她們到了B專櫃）
text.simplified: （她们到了B专柜）
text.pinyin: (Tāmen dào le B zhuānguì)
text.english: (They reach Counter B.)

text.traditional: 沒想到這個專櫃的衣服這麼便宜，設計也不錯，難怪顧客這麼多。我看，在這裡找就行了。
text.simplified: 没想到这个专柜的衣服这么便宜，设计也不错，难怪顾客这么多。我看，在这里找就行了。
text.pinyin: Méixiǎngdào zhè ge zhuānguì de yīfu zhème piányí, shèjì yě búcuò, nánguài gùkè zhème duō. Wǒ kàn, zài zhèlǐ zhǎo jiù xíng le.
text.english: I didn't expect the clothes at this counter to be so cheap and well-designed; no wonder there are so many customers. I think finding something here will be fine.

text.traditional: 是比較便宜。不過，我朋友在這裡買過顏色相同的情侶裝，沒穿幾次就破了，最後只好扔掉。
text.simplified: 是比较便宜。不过，我朋友在这里买过颜色相同的情侣装，没穿几次就破了，最后只好扔掉。
text.pinyin: Shì bǐjiào piányí. Búguò, wǒ péngyǒu zài zhèlǐ mǎi guò yánsè xiāngtóng de qínglǚ zhuāng, méi chuān jǐ cì jiù pò le, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo rēngdiào.
text.english: It is cheaper. But a friend of mine bought matching couple's outfits here; after wearing them just a few times they tore, and in the end they had to throw them away.

text.traditional: 我也有差不多的經驗。以前我買過很便宜的牛仔褲，只穿了一天，皮膚就紅起來了，非常不舒服。後來吃了三天的藥才好，真是受不了。
text.simplified: 我也有差不多的经验。以前我买过很便宜的牛仔裤，只穿了一天，皮肤就红起来了，非常不舒服。后来吃了三天的药才好，真是受不了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yě yǒu chàbùduō de jīngyàn. Yǐqián wǒ mǎi guò hěn piányí de niúzǎikù, zhǐ chuān le yì tiān, pífū jiù hóng qǐlái le, fēicháng bù shūfu. Hòulái chī le sān tiān de yào cái hǎo, zhēnshì shòubùliǎo.
text.english: I had a similar experience. I once bought very cheap jeans; after wearing them for just one day, my skin broke out in red and was terribly uncomfortable. I had to take medicine for three days before getting better; it was truly unbearable.

text.traditional: 便宜沒好貨嘛！為了省錢買了品質差的東西，最後吃虧的還是自己。
text.simplified: 便宜没好货嘛！为了省钱买了品质差的东西，最后吃亏的还是自己。
text.pinyin: Piányí méi hǎo huò ma! Wèile shěngqián mǎi le pǐnzhí chà de dōngxi, zuìhòu chīkuī de háishì zìjǐ.
text.english: You get what you pay for! Buying poor-quality things just to save money—in the end, the one who suffers the loss is yourself.

text.traditional: 嗯，說的沒錯。我們還是去別家吧。
text.simplified: 嗯，说的没错。我们还是去别家吧。
text.pinyin: Ēn, shuō de méicuò. Wǒmen háishì qù bié jiā ba.
text.english: Mm, that's so true. Let's go to another shop instead.

text.traditional: （她們到了C專櫃，店員給她們介紹了各式各樣的衣服，還提到今天有打折活動。）
text.simplified: （她们到了C专柜，店员给她们介绍了各式各样的衣服，还提到今天有打折活动。）
text.pinyin: (Tāmen dào le C zhuānguì, diànyuán gěi tāmen jièshào le gèshìgèyàng de yīfu, hái tídào jīntiān yǒu dǎzhé huódòng.)
text.english: (They reach Counter C. The clerk shows them all kinds of clothes and mentions a sale today.)

text.traditional: 我覺得這個專櫃什麼都好，就是價格高了很多。
text.simplified: 我觉得这个专柜什么都好，就是价格高了很多。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè ge zhuānguì shénme dōu hǎo, jiùshì jiàgé gāo le hěn duō.
text.english: I feel everything at this counter is great, except the prices are much higher.

text.traditional: 沒關係，專櫃小姐一直強調他們的衣服平時不打折，只有今天打六折，可以省不少錢喔！
text.simplified: 没关系，专柜小姐一直强调他们的衣服平时不打折，只有今天打六折，可以省不少钱喔！
text.pinyin: Méiguānxi, zhuānguì xiǎojiě yìzhí qiángdiào tāmen de yīfu píngshí bù dǎzhé, zhǐyǒu jīntiān dǎ liù zhé, kěyǐ shěng bùshǎo qián o!
text.english: That's fine; the sales clerk kept emphasizing that their clothes are usually not discounted, and only today they are 40% off—you can save quite a bit of money!

text.traditional: 真的嗎？那我趕快找找合適的。
text.simplified: 真的吗？那我赶快找找合适的。
text.pinyin: Zhēnde ma? Nà wǒ gǎnkuài zhǎo zhǎo héshì de.
text.english: Really? Then I'll quickly look for something suitable.

text.traditional: （芳草試穿了一件洋裝後）
text.simplified: （芳草试穿了一件洋装后）
text.pinyin: (Fāngcǎo shìchuān le yí jiàn yángzhuāng hòu)
text.english: (After Fangcao tries on a dress)

text.traditional: 這件我很滿意，肩膀的大小也沒問題。妳覺得呢？
text.simplified: 这件我很满意，肩膀的大小也没问题。你觉得呢？
text.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wǒ hěn mǎnyì, jiānbǎng de dàxiǎo yě méi wèntí. Nǐ juéde ne?
text.english: I'm very satisfied with this one, and the shoulder fit is fine. What do you think?

text.traditional: 嗯，好看。參加婚禮或是平常上課穿都很合適。
text.simplified: 嗯，好看。参加婚礼或是平常上课穿都很合适。
text.pinyin: Ēn, hǎokàn. Cānjiā hūnlǐ huòshì píngcháng shàngkè chuān dōu hěn héshì.
text.english: Mm, looks good. It would work well both for a wedding and for wearing to class every day.

text.traditional: 是啊，而且打了折就便宜多了。我還看到好幾件漂亮的外套、長褲，趁今天打折的好機會，我要多買幾件給我的姊妹。
text.simplified: 是啊，而且打了折就便宜多了。我还看到好几件漂亮的外套、长裤，趁今天打折的好机会，我要多买几件给我的姊妹。
text.pinyin: Shì a, érqiě dǎ le zhé jiù piányí duō le. Wǒ hái kàndào hǎojǐ jiàn piàoliàng de wàitào, chángkù, chèn jīntiān dǎzhé de hǎo jīhuì, wǒ yào duō mǎi jǐ jiàn gěi wǒ de jiěmèi.
text.english: Yeah, and with the discount it's much cheaper. I also saw several pretty jackets and trousers; taking advantage of today's discount opportunity, I want to buy a few more for my sisters.

text.traditional: （芳草又選了一件外套，兩件襯衫。）
text.simplified: （芳草又选了一件外套，两件衬衫。）
text.pinyin: (Fāngcǎo yòu xuǎn le yí jiàn wàitào, liǎng jiàn chènshān.)
text.english: (Fangcao also picks out a jacket and two shirts.)

text.traditional: 好了，好了，別再買了，妳還要去看球鞋呢！
text.simplified: 好了，好了，别再买了，你还要去看球鞋呢！
text.pinyin: Hǎo le, hǎo le, bié zài mǎi le, nǐ hái yào qù kàn qiúxié ne!
text.english: All right, all right, don't buy any more; you still have to go look at sneakers!

text.traditional: 好好好，我就買這幾件。
text.simplified: 好好好，我就买这几件。
text.pinyin: Hǎo hǎo hǎo, wǒ jiù mǎi zhè jǐ jiàn.
text.english: Okay okay, I'll just buy these few pieces.

text.traditional: （付錢的時候）
text.simplified: （付钱的时候）
text.pinyin: (Fù qián de shíhòu)
text.english: (When they pay)

text.traditional: 小姐，這是您的發票，您購買的商品如果有任何問題，七天以內都可以換。
text.simplified: 小姐，这是您的发票，您购买的商品如果有任何问题，七天以内都可以换。
text.pinyin: Xiǎojiě, zhè shì nín de fāpiào, nín gòumǎi de shāngpǐn rúguǒ yǒu rènhé wèntí, qī tiān yǐnèi dōu kěyǐ huàn.
text.english: Miss, here is your receipt; if there are any issues with your purchased merchandise, you can exchange them within seven days.

text.traditional: 好的，謝謝妳。
text.simplified: 好的，谢谢你。
text.pinyin: Hǎo de, xièxie nǐ.
text.english: Great, thank you.

text.traditional: （她們離開專櫃後）
text.simplified: （她们离开专柜后）
text.pinyin: (Tāmen líkāi zhuānguì hòu)
text.english: (After they leave the counter)

text.traditional: 這個專櫃的小姐真體貼，不但用漂亮的紙把衣服包起來，還很小心地放進袋子裡。像她那樣的服務態度，讓我覺得很滿意。
text.simplified: 这个专柜的小姐真体贴，不但用漂亮的纸把衣服包起来，还很小心地放进袋子里。像她那样的服务态度，让我觉得很满意。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge zhuānguì de xiǎojiě zhēn tǐtiē, búdàn yòng piàoliàng de zhǐ bǎ yīfu bāo qǐlái, hái hěn xiǎoxīn de fàng jìn dàizi lǐ. Xiàng tā nàyàng de fúwù tàidù, ràng wǒ juéde hěn mǎnyì.
text.english: The sales assistant at this counter is so thoughtful; she not only wrapped the clothes in nice paper, but also put them carefully into the bag. Service like hers makes me feel very satisfied.

text.traditional: 這就是「貨比三家不吃虧」的道理啊！還好我們看了三家，又比了比價錢、品質，要不然恐怕花了錢還不開心呢！
text.simplified: 这就是「货比三家不吃亏」的道理啊！还好我们看了三家，又比了比价钱、品质，要不然恐怕花了钱还不开心呢！
text.pinyin: Zhè jiù shì “huòbǐsānjiā bù chīkuī” de dàolǐ a! Háihǎo wǒmen kàn le sān jiā, yòu bǐ le bǐ jiàqián, pǐnzhí, yàobùrán kǒngpà huā le qián hái bù kāixīn ne!
text.english: That's the logic of "shopping around won't hurt"! Luckily we visited three counters and compared the price and quality, otherwise we might have spent money and ended up unhappy!

text.traditional: 華人常說「貨比三家不吃虧」，意思是購物時要多看幾家店，不僅要比一比價格，還要比一比品質。這樣才能買得開心、用得放心。
text.simplified: 华人常说「货比三家不吃亏」，意思是购物时要多看几家店，不仅要比一比价格，还要比一比品质。这样才能买得开心、用得放心。
text.pinyin: Huárén cháng shuō “huòbǐsānjiā bù chīkuī”, yìsi shì gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, bù jǐn yào bǐ yì bǐ jiàgé, hái yào bǐ yì bǐ pǐnzhí. Zhèyàng cái néng mǎi de kāixīn, yòng de fàngxīn.
text.english: Chinese people often say "compare prices at three stores so you won't suffer a loss," meaning that when shopping one should check out several shops, comparing not only prices but also quality. Only in this way can one buy happily and use with peace of mind.

text.traditional: 在臺灣，只要一提到買便宜的東西，大家就會想到夜市或地攤。那裡的商品常常是一樣比一樣便宜。攤販都努力地向客人推銷，希望客人把錢從口袋裡拿出來、把商品都帶走。不過有的客人非常聰明，完全沒忘記品質和價格一樣重要，不管攤販在他們面前說什麼，都不會糊里糊塗地亂買。他們會把每個攤子都看一看、找一找，想辦法買到實在又優惠的商品。
text.simplified: 在台湾，只要一提到买便宜的东西，大家就会想到夜市或地摊。那里的商品常常是一样比一样便宜。摊贩都努力地向客人推销，希望客人把钱从口袋里拿出来、把商品都带走。不过有的客人非常聪明，完全没忘记品质和价格一样重要，不管摊贩在他们面前说什么，都不会糊里糊涂地乱买。他们会把每个摊子都看一看、找一找，想办法买到实在又优惠的商品。
text.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, zhǐyào yì tídào mǎi piányí de dōngxi, dàjiā jiù huì xiǎngdào yèshì huò dìtān. Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng bǐ yí yàng piányí. Tānfàn dōu nǔlì de xiàng kèrén tuīxiāo, xīwàng kèrén bǎ qián cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū lái, bǎ shāngpǐn dōu dài zǒu. Búguò yǒude kèrén fēicháng cōngmíng, wánquán méi wàngjì pǐnzhí hàn jiàgé yíyàng zhòngyào, bùguǎn tānfàn zài tāmen miànqián shuō shénme, dōu bú huì húlǐhútú de luàn mǎi. Tāmen huì bǎ měi ge tānzi dōu kàn yí kàn, zhǎo yì zhǎo, xiǎng bànfǎ mǎi dào shízài yòu yōuhuì de shāngpǐn.
text.english: In Taiwan, whenever buying cheap things is mentioned, everyone thinks of night markets or street stalls. There, each item is often cheaper than the last. Vendors strive to pitch to customers, hoping they will take money out of their pockets and take merchandise away. However, some customers are very smart and never forget that quality is as important as price; no matter what vendors say to them, they never buy blindly or foolishly. They inspect and search every stall to figure out how to purchase solid and discounted goods.

text.traditional: 以購物習慣來說，一般人除了去商店、超市買東西，網路購物也早就流行了。網路商店提供各式各樣的商品，從碗筷、雨傘、行李箱等生活用品，到電腦、廚房、露營等的設備都找得到，也看得到價格和生產地區，所以網路購物能幫我們節省不少比價和交通的時間。
text.simplified: 以购物习惯来说，一般人除了去商店、超市买东西，网路购物也早就流行了。网路商店提供各式各样的商品，从碗筷、雨伞、行李箱等生活用品，到电脑、厨房、露营等的设备都找得到，也看得到价格和生产地区，所以网路购物能帮我们节省不少比价和交通的时间。
text.pinyin: Yǐ gòuwù xíguàn lái shuō, yìbānrén chúle qù shāngdiàn, chāoshì mǎi dōngxi, wǎnglù gòuwù yě zǎojiù liúxíng le. Wǎnglù shāngdiàn tígōng gèshìgèyàng de shāngpǐn, cóng wǎn kuài, yǔsǎn, xínglǐxiāng děng shēnghuó yòngpǐn, dào diànnǎo, chúfáng, lùyíng děng de shèbèi dōu zhǎo de dào, yě kàn de dào jiàgé hàn shēngchǎn dìqū, suǒyǐ wǎnglù gòuwù néng bāng wǒmen jiéshěng bùshǎo bǐjià hàn jiāotōng de shíjiān.
text.english: In terms of shopping habits, besides going to stores and supermarkets, most people have long been shopping online too. Online stores offer all kinds of goods: from daily necessities like bowls, chopsticks, umbrellas, and luggage, to equipment for computers, kitchens, and camping. Prices and places of manufacture can all be checked, so online shopping saves us a lot of time on price comparison and commuting.

text.traditional: 其實不管採用哪一種購物方式，都有它的優點和缺點。只有想清楚自己到底需要什麼，仔細地讀商品說明，認真地比價格、比品質，這樣才是聰明顧客的最佳選擇。就算眼光很高的人，也保證能夠買到滿意的商品。
text.simplified: 其实不管采用哪一种购物方式，都有它的优点和缺点。只有想清楚自己到底需要什么，仔细地读商品说明，认真地比价格、比品质，这样才是聪明顾客的最佳选择。就算眼光很高的人，也保证能够买到满意的商品。
text.pinyin: Qíshí bùguǎn cǎiyòng nǎ yì zhǒng gòuwù fāngshì, dōu yǒu tā de yōudiǎn hàn quēdiǎn. Zhǐyǒu xiǎng qīngchǔ zìjǐ dàodǐ xūyào shénme, zǐxì de dú shāngpǐn shuōmíng, rènzhēn de bǐ jiàgé, bǐ pǐnzhí, zhèyàng cái shì cōngmíng gùkè de zuìjiā xuǎnzé. Jiùsuàn yǎnguāng hěn gāo de rén, yě bǎozhèng nénggòu mǎi dào mǎnyì de shāngpǐn.
text.english: In reality, no matter which shopping method one adopts, each has its advantages and disadvantages. Only by clearly knowing what you really need, carefully reading product descriptions, and seriously comparing price and quality can you make the smart customer's optimal choice. Even those with very discerning tastes are guaranteed to find satisfactory products.

LESSON_THREE_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–4 · It Won't Hurt to Shop Around

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say you try something out (試穿, 試喝) before deciding to buy or use it, with 試 + verb.
grammarPages.explanation: 決定購買或使用某物品以前，先試試看是不是真的喜歡、真的合適。這個「V」常是單音節的動詞，例如：吃、穿、用、喝、開等。

text.traditional: 這套淺色的也很好看，妳都試穿一下吧！
text.simplified: 这套浅色的也很好看，你都试穿一下吧！
text.pinyin: Zhè tào qiǎnsè de yě hěn hǎokàn, nǐ dōu shìchuān yíxià ba!
text.english: This light-colored outfit looks nice too. Go ahead and try them both on!

text.traditional: 買床的時候一定要試躺，覺得舒服再買。
text.simplified: 买床的时候一定要试躺，觉得舒服再买。
text.pinyin: Mǎi chuáng de shíhòu yídìng yào shì tǎng, juéde shūfu zài mǎi.
text.english: When buying a bed you must try lying down on it, and only buy if it feels comfortable.

text.traditional: 那家超商提供新口味的飲料給客人免費試喝，喝過的人都說好喝。
text.simplified: 那家超商提供新口味的饮料给客人免费试喝，喝过的人都说好喝。
text.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshāng tígōng xīn kǒuwèi de yǐnliào gěi kèrén miǎnfèi shì hē, hē guò de rén dōu shuō hǎohē.
text.english: That convenience store is letting customers taste its new-flavor drink for free, and everyone who has tried it says it's delicious.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Before deciding to buy a product or to use it, first try to see if you really like it or if it is really suitable. There "V" are often monosyllable verbs, such as 吃, 穿, 用, 喝, 開, etc.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say something is thrown away, sold off, used up or gone with verb + 掉 (扔掉, 賣掉, 跑掉).
grammarPages.explanation: 「掉」是補語，用在及物動詞的後面，有去除或出現不好的結果的意思，例如：吃掉、扔掉、賣掉、拿掉等。如果「掉」用在不及物動詞的後面，表示離開的意思，例如：走掉、飛掉、跑掉、壞掉等。

text.traditional: ……沒穿幾次就破了，最後只好扔掉。
text.simplified: ……没穿几次就破了，最后只好扔掉。
text.pinyin: …Méi chuān jǐ cì jiù pò le, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo rēngdiào.
text.english: …They tore after being worn only a few times, so in the end they had no choice but to throw them away.

text.traditional:
A：你那輛車不常開又舊得很，不如賣掉吧！
B：它還能開，賣掉太可惜了。
text.simplified:
A：你那辆车不常开又旧得很，不如卖掉吧！
B：它还能开，卖掉太可惜了。
text.pinyin:
A: Nǐ nà liàng chē bù cháng kāi yòu jiù dehěn, bùrú màidiào ba!
B: Tā hái néng kāi, màidiào tài kěxí le.
text.english:
A: You don't drive that car much, and it's really old. You might as well sell it!
B: It still runs. Selling it would be a real shame.

text.traditional:
A：我擔心送皮鞋給男朋友，他會跑掉。
B：那就送他皮帶好了，這樣他就跑不掉了。
text.simplified:
A：我担心送皮鞋给男朋友，他会跑掉。
B：那就送他皮带好了，这样他就跑不掉了。
text.pinyin:
A: Wǒ dānxīn sòng píxié gěi nánpéngyǒu, tā huì pǎodiào.
B: Nà jiù sòng tā pídài hǎo le, zhèyàng tā jiù pǎo bú diào le.
text.english:
A: I'm worried that if I give my boyfriend leather shoes, he'll run off.
B: Then just give him a belt. That way he won't be able to run off.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The complement 掉 is used after the transitive verb, and it means to remove or produce bad results, such as 吃掉, 扔掉, 賣掉, 拿掉, etc. If the complement 掉 is used after the intransitive verb, it means to leave. For example, 走掉, 飛掉, 跑掉, 壞掉, etc.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say something is true of anything or everything except one thing, using 什麼（……）都……，就是…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「什麼（……）都……」表示「全部、任何」，例如：「他什麼忙都幫」表示他任何忙都會幫，「我什麼東西都吃」表示任何東西我都吃。而「就是」的後面是唯一的選擇或不同的情況。例如：他什麼茶都喝，就是不喝紅茶。
grammarPages.pattern: 什麼 (+ Noun) + 都 + Verb / Adjective，就是 + Exception

text.traditional: 我覺得這個專櫃什麼都好，就是價格高了很多。
text.simplified: 我觉得这个专柜什么都好，就是价格高了很多。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè ge zhuānguì shénme dōu hǎo, jiùshì jiàgé gāo le hěn duō.
text.english: I think everything about this counter is great, except that its prices are a lot higher.

text.traditional: 我剛大學畢業，什麼工作都願意做，就是不能接受老闆要我每天加班。
text.simplified: 我刚大学毕业，什么工作都愿意做，就是不能接受老板要我每天加班。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gāng dàxué bìyè, shénme gōngzuò dōu yuànyì zuò, jiùshì bùnéng jiēshòu lǎobǎn yào wǒ měi tiān jiābān.
text.english: I've just graduated from college, and I'm willing to do any kind of job; the only thing I can't accept is a boss who wants me to work overtime every day.

text.traditional: 文小姐從設計學校畢業後，什麼服裝都設計過，就是沒設計過帽子。
text.simplified: 文小姐从设计学校毕业后，什么服装都设计过，就是没设计过帽子。
text.pinyin: Wén xiǎojiě cóng shèjì xuéxiào bìyè hòu, shénme fúzhuāng dōu shèjì guò, jiùshì méi shèjì guò màozi.
text.english: Since graduating from design school, Miss Wen has designed all kinds of clothing; the only thing she has never designed is hats.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 什麼(N)都……，就是…… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 什麼（……）都…… means "all, anything", for example, 他什麼忙都幫 means "He will help with anything." And 我什麼東西都吃 means "I will eat anything." The statement after 就是 means the only option or different situation. For example, 他什麼茶都喝，就是不喝紅茶。

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Tell someone to stop doing something with 別再……了, or say that you or someone else won't do it anymore with 不再……了.
grammarPages.explanation: 「別再……了」的意思是，說話的人建議或提醒對方不要再做某件事情了，例如：別再讓父母擔心了。如果說話的人要提醒自己或敘述別人不再做某件事情了，就使用「不再……了」，例如：我不再喝酒了。
grammarPages.pattern: 別再 + Action + 了 / 不再 + Action + 了

patternTable.title: Urging Cessation or Stating No Longer

text.traditional: ……別再買了，妳還要去看球鞋呢！
text.simplified: ……别再买了，你还要去看球鞋呢！
text.pinyin: …Bié zài mǎi le, nǐ hái yào qù kàn qiúxié ne!
text.english: … Don't buy any more; you still have to go look at sneakers!

text.traditional:
孩子：你別再幫我洗衣服了！我自己會洗。
媽媽：我怕你洗不乾淨，如果洗得乾淨，我就不再幫你洗了。
text.simplified:
孩子：你别再帮我洗衣服了！我自己会洗。
妈妈：我怕你洗不干净，如果洗得干净，我就不再帮你洗了。
text.pinyin:
Háizi: Nǐ bié zài bāng wǒ xǐ yīfu le! Wǒ zìjǐ huì xǐ.
Māma: Wǒ pà nǐ xǐ bù gānjìng, rúguǒ xǐ de gānjìng, wǒ jiù bú zài bāng nǐ xǐ le.
text.english:
Child: Don't wash my clothes for me anymore! I can wash them myself.
Mom: I'm afraid you won't get them clean. If you can get them clean, I won't wash them for you anymore.

text.traditional:
太太：你的腳受傷了，別再踢足球了。
先生：要是這次比賽輸了，我就不再踢了。
text.simplified:
太太：你的脚受伤了，别再踢足球了。
先生：要是这次比赛输了，我就不再踢了。
text.pinyin:
Tàitai: Nǐ de jiǎo shòushāng le, bié zài tī zúqiú le.
Xiānshēng: Yàoshì zhè cì bǐsài shū le, wǒ jiù bú zài tī le.
text.english:
Wife: Your foot is injured; don't play soccer anymore.
Husband: If we lose this match, I won't play anymore.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 別再……了 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 別再……了 means that the person speaking suggests or reminds the other person not to do something anymore. For example, 別再讓父母擔心了。If the speaker reminds himself or mentions that others are not doing something anymore, use 不再……了. For example, 我不再喝酒了。

dialogue.title: 對話 · 貨比三家不吃虧 · It Won’t Hurt to Shop Around

text.traditional: 芳草，妳也來逛百貨公司啊！
text.simplified: 芳草，你也来逛百货公司啊！
text.pinyin: Fāngcǎo, nǐ yě lái guàng bǎihuò gōngsī a!
text.english: Fangcao, you're shopping at the department store too!

text.traditional: 是啊！我下個月要參加朋友的婚禮，來買件合適的衣服。妳呢？怎麼也來了？
text.simplified: 是啊！我下个月要参加朋友的婚礼，来买件合适的衣服。你呢？怎么也来了？
text.pinyin: Shì a! Wǒ xià ge yuè yào cānjiā péngyǒu de hūnlǐ, lái mǎi jiàn héshì de yīfu. Nǐ ne? Zěnme yě lái le?
text.english: Yes! I'm attending a friend's wedding next month and came to buy a suitable outfit. What about you? How come you came too?

text.traditional: 這家百貨公司正在打折，我特地來買上衣。要不要一起逛逛？
text.simplified: 这家百货公司正在打折，我特地来买上衣。要不要一起逛逛？
text.pinyin: Zhè jiā bǎihuò gōngsī zhèngzài dǎzhé, wǒ tèdì lái mǎi shàngyī. Yào búyào yìqǐ guàngguang?
text.english: This department store is currently having a sale, so I specially came to buy a top. Want to browse together?

text.traditional: 好啊，順便請妳給我一些意見。我們先上二樓看看，那裡有各式各樣的衣服、皮帶、皮鞋。如果有時間，我也想買一雙球鞋給我先生。
text.simplified: 好啊，顺便请你给我一些意见。我们先上二楼看看，那里有各式各样的衣服、皮带、皮鞋。如果有时间，我也想买一双球鞋给我先生。
text.pinyin: Hǎo a, shùnbiàn qǐng nǐ gěi wǒ yìxiē yìjiàn. Wǒmen xiān shàng èr lóu kànkan, nàlǐ yǒu gèshìgèyàng de yīfu, pídài, píxié. Rúguǒ yǒu shíjiān, wǒ yě xiǎng mǎi yì shuāng qiúxié gěi wǒ xiānshēng.
text.english: Sure, and while we're at it, you can give me some advice. Let's go up to the second floor first to take a look; they have all kinds of clothes, belts, and leather shoes. If there is time, I also want to buy a pair of sneakers for my husband.

text.traditional: （她們到了二樓A專櫃）
text.simplified: （她们到了二楼A专柜）
text.pinyin: (Tāmen dào le èr lóu A zhuānguì)
text.english: (They reach Counter A on the second floor.)

text.traditional: 這個專櫃的衣服都不錯，模特兒身上那件深藍色的洋裝，設計得很有特色，看起來很適合參加婚禮。
text.simplified: 这个专柜的衣服都不错，模特儿身上那件深蓝色的洋装，设计得很有特色，看起来很适合参加婚礼。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge zhuānguì de yīfu dōu búcuò, mótèr shēnshàng nà jiàn shēn lánsè de yángzhuāng, shèjì de hěn yǒu tèsè, kànqǐlái hěn shìhé cānjiā hūnlǐ.
text.english: The clothes at this counter are all nice; that navy blue dress on the mannequin has a really distinctive design, and it looks perfect for a wedding.

text.traditional: 嗯，這套淺色的也很好看，妳都試穿一下吧！
text.simplified: 嗯，这套浅色的也很好看，你都试穿一下吧！
text.pinyin: Ēn, zhè tào qiǎnsè de yě hěn hǎokàn, nǐ dōu shìchuān yíxià ba!
text.english: Mm, this light-colored outfit looks nice too. Go ahead and try them both on!

text.traditional: （芳草先試穿了深藍色的洋裝後）
text.simplified: （芳草先试穿了深蓝色的洋装后）
text.pinyin: (Fāngcǎo xiān shìchuān le shēn lánsè de yángzhuāng hòu)
text.english: (After Fangcao tries on the navy dress)

text.traditional: 不錯喔！妳的個子高，穿起洋裝來挺好看的。
text.simplified: 不错喔！你的个子高，穿起洋装来挺好看的。
text.pinyin: Búcuò o! Nǐ de gèzi gāo, chuān qǐ yángzhuāng lái tǐng hǎo kàn de.
text.english: Not bad! You're tall, so you look quite nice wearing a dress.

text.traditional: 是挺好看的。不過，價錢有點兒貴，樣子也太正式了，恐怕平常沒什麼機會穿。我再試穿那件淺色的吧！
text.simplified: 是挺好看的。不过，价钱有点儿贵，样子也太正式了，恐怕平常没什么机会穿。我再试穿那件浅色的吧！
text.pinyin: Shì tǐng hǎo kàn de. Búguò, jiàqián yǒudiǎnr guì, yàngzi yě tài zhèngshì le, kǒngpà píngcháng méishénme jīhuì chuān. Wǒ zài shìchuān nà jiàn qiǎnsè de ba!
text.english: It does look quite nice. However, the price is a bit steep and the style is too formal; I'm afraid I wouldn't have much chance to wear it normally. Let me try on that light-colored one!

text.traditional: （芳草試穿了淺色的衣服後）
text.simplified: （芳草试穿了浅色的衣服后）
text.pinyin: (Fāngcǎo shìchuān le qiǎnsè de yīfu hòu)
text.english: (After Fangcao tries on the light-colored outfit)

text.traditional: 這件穿起來有點兒緊，而且比剛才那件還要貴。算了，去別家吧。
text.simplified: 这件穿起来有点儿紧，而且比刚才那件还要贵。算了，去别家吧。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiàn chuān qǐlái yǒudiǎnr jǐn, érqiě bǐ gāngcái nà jiàn háiyào guì. Suànle, qù bié jiā ba.
text.english: This one feels a bit tight, and it's even more expensive than the last one. Forget it, let's go somewhere else.

text.traditional: （她們到了B專櫃）
text.simplified: （她们到了B专柜）
text.pinyin: (Tāmen dào le B zhuānguì)
text.english: (They reach Counter B.)

text.traditional: 沒想到這個專櫃的衣服這麼便宜，設計也不錯，難怪顧客這麼多。我看，在這裡找就行了。
text.simplified: 没想到这个专柜的衣服这么便宜，设计也不错，难怪顾客这么多。我看，在这里找就行了。
text.pinyin: Méixiǎngdào zhè ge zhuānguì de yīfu zhème piányí, shèjì yě búcuò, nánguài gùkè zhème duō. Wǒ kàn, zài zhèlǐ zhǎo jiù xíng le.
text.english: I didn't expect the clothes at this counter to be so cheap and well-designed; no wonder there are so many customers. I think finding something here will be fine.

text.traditional: 是比較便宜。不過，我朋友在這裡買過顏色相同的情侶裝，沒穿幾次就破了，最後只好扔掉。
text.simplified: 是比较便宜。不过，我朋友在这里买过颜色相同的情侣装，没穿几次就破了，最后只好扔掉。
text.pinyin: Shì bǐjiào piányí. Búguò, wǒ péngyǒu zài zhèlǐ mǎi guò yánsè xiāngtóng de qínglǚ zhuāng, méi chuān jǐ cì jiù pò le, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo rēngdiào.
text.english: It is cheaper. But a friend of mine bought matching couple's outfits here; after wearing them just a few times they tore, and in the end they had to throw them away.

text.traditional: 我也有差不多的經驗。以前我買過很便宜的牛仔褲，只穿了一天，皮膚就紅起來了，非常不舒服。後來吃了三天的藥才好，真是受不了。
text.simplified: 我也有差不多的经验。以前我买过很便宜的牛仔裤，只穿了一天，皮肤就红起来了，非常不舒服。后来吃了三天的药才好，真是受不了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yě yǒu chàbùduō de jīngyàn. Yǐqián wǒ mǎi guò hěn piányí de niúzǎikù, zhǐ chuān le yì tiān, pífū jiù hóng qǐlái le, fēicháng bù shūfu. Hòulái chī le sān tiān de yào cái hǎo, zhēnshì shòubùliǎo.
text.english: I had a similar experience. I once bought very cheap jeans; after wearing them for just one day, my skin broke out in red and was terribly uncomfortable. I had to take medicine for three days before getting better; it was truly unbearable.

text.traditional: 便宜沒好貨嘛！為了省錢買了品質差的東西，最後吃虧的還是自己。
text.simplified: 便宜没好货嘛！为了省钱买了品质差的东西，最后吃亏的还是自己。
text.pinyin: Piányí méi hǎo huò ma! Wèile shěngqián mǎi le pǐnzhí chà de dōngxi, zuìhòu chīkuī de háishì zìjǐ.
text.english: You get what you pay for! Buying poor-quality things just to save money—in the end, the one who suffers the loss is yourself.

text.traditional: 嗯，說的沒錯。我們還是去別家吧。
text.simplified: 嗯，说的没错。我们还是去别家吧。
text.pinyin: Ēn, shuō de méicuò. Wǒmen háishì qù bié jiā ba.
text.english: Mm, that's so true. Let's go to another shop instead.

text.traditional: （她們到了C專櫃，店員給她們介紹了各式各樣的衣服，還提到今天有打折活動。）
text.simplified: （她们到了C专柜，店员给她们介绍了各式各样的衣服，还提到今天有打折活动。）
text.pinyin: (Tāmen dào le C zhuānguì, diànyuán gěi tāmen jièshào le gèshìgèyàng de yīfu, hái tídào jīntiān yǒu dǎzhé huódòng.)
text.english: (They reach Counter C. The clerk shows them all kinds of clothes and mentions a sale today.)

text.traditional: 我覺得這個專櫃什麼都好，就是價格高了很多。
text.simplified: 我觉得这个专柜什么都好，就是价格高了很多。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè ge zhuānguì shénme dōu hǎo, jiùshì jiàgé gāo le hěn duō.
text.english: I feel everything at this counter is great, except the prices are much higher.

text.traditional: 沒關係，專櫃小姐一直強調他們的衣服平時不打折，只有今天打六折，可以省不少錢喔！
text.simplified: 没关系，专柜小姐一直强调他们的衣服平时不打折，只有今天打六折，可以省不少钱喔！
text.pinyin: Méiguānxi, zhuānguì xiǎojiě yìzhí qiángdiào tāmen de yīfu píngshí bù dǎzhé, zhǐyǒu jīntiān dǎ liù zhé, kěyǐ shěng bùshǎo qián o!
text.english: That's fine; the sales clerk kept emphasizing that their clothes are usually not discounted, and only today they are 40% off—you can save quite a bit of money!

text.traditional: 真的嗎？那我趕快找找合適的。
text.simplified: 真的吗？那我赶快找找合适的。
text.pinyin: Zhēnde ma? Nà wǒ gǎnkuài zhǎo zhǎo héshì de.
text.english: Really? Then I'll quickly look for something suitable.

text.traditional: （芳草試穿了一件洋裝後）
text.simplified: （芳草试穿了一件洋装后）
text.pinyin: (Fāngcǎo shìchuān le yí jiàn yángzhuāng hòu)
text.english: (After Fangcao tries on a dress)

text.traditional: 這件我很滿意，肩膀的大小也沒問題。妳覺得呢？
text.simplified: 这件我很满意，肩膀的大小也没问题。你觉得呢？
text.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wǒ hěn mǎnyì, jiānbǎng de dàxiǎo yě méi wèntí. Nǐ juéde ne?
text.english: I'm very satisfied with this one, and the shoulder fit is fine. What do you think?

text.traditional: 嗯，好看。參加婚禮或是平常上課穿都很合適。
text.simplified: 嗯，好看。参加婚礼或是平常上课穿都很合适。
text.pinyin: Ēn, hǎokàn. Cānjiā hūnlǐ huòshì píngcháng shàngkè chuān dōu hěn héshì.
text.english: Mm, looks good. It would work well both for a wedding and for wearing to class every day.

text.traditional: 是啊，而且打了折就便宜多了。我還看到好幾件漂亮的外套、長褲，趁今天打折的好機會，我要多買幾件給我的姊妹。
text.simplified: 是啊，而且打了折就便宜多了。我还看到好几件漂亮的外套、长裤，趁今天打折的好机会，我要多买几件给我的姊妹。
text.pinyin: Shì a, érqiě dǎ le zhé jiù piányí duō le. Wǒ hái kàndào hǎojǐ jiàn piàoliàng de wàitào, chángkù, chèn jīntiān dǎzhé de hǎo jīhuì, wǒ yào duō mǎi jǐ jiàn gěi wǒ de jiěmèi.
text.english: Yeah, and with the discount it's much cheaper. I also saw several pretty jackets and trousers; taking advantage of today's discount opportunity, I want to buy a few more for my sisters.

text.traditional: （芳草又選了一件外套，兩件襯衫。）
text.simplified: （芳草又选了一件外套，两件衬衫。）
text.pinyin: (Fāngcǎo yòu xuǎn le yí jiàn wàitào, liǎng jiàn chènshān.)
text.english: (Fangcao also picks out a jacket and two shirts.)

text.traditional: 好了，好了，別再買了，妳還要去看球鞋呢！
text.simplified: 好了，好了，别再买了，你还要去看球鞋呢！
text.pinyin: Hǎo le, hǎo le, bié zài mǎi le, nǐ hái yào qù kàn qiúxié ne!
text.english: All right, all right, don't buy any more; you still have to go look at sneakers!

text.traditional: 好好好，我就買這幾件。
text.simplified: 好好好，我就买这几件。
text.pinyin: Hǎo hǎo hǎo, wǒ jiù mǎi zhè jǐ jiàn.
text.english: Okay okay, I'll just buy these few pieces.

text.traditional: （付錢的時候）
text.simplified: （付钱的时候）
text.pinyin: (Fù qián de shíhòu)
text.english: (When they pay)

text.traditional: 小姐，這是您的發票，您購買的商品如果有任何問題，七天以內都可以換。
text.simplified: 小姐，这是您的发票，您购买的商品如果有任何问题，七天以内都可以换。
text.pinyin: Xiǎojiě, zhè shì nín de fāpiào, nín gòumǎi de shāngpǐn rúguǒ yǒu rènhé wèntí, qī tiān yǐnèi dōu kěyǐ huàn.
text.english: Miss, here is your receipt; if there are any issues with your purchased merchandise, you can exchange them within seven days.

text.traditional: 好的，謝謝妳。
text.simplified: 好的，谢谢你。
text.pinyin: Hǎo de, xièxie nǐ.
text.english: Great, thank you.

text.traditional: （她們離開專櫃後）
text.simplified: （她们离开专柜后）
text.pinyin: (Tāmen líkāi zhuānguì hòu)
text.english: (After they leave the counter)

text.traditional: 這個專櫃的小姐真體貼，不但用漂亮的紙把衣服包起來，還很小心地放進袋子裡。像她那樣的服務態度，讓我覺得很滿意。
text.simplified: 这个专柜的小姐真体贴，不但用漂亮的纸把衣服包起来，还很小心地放进袋子里。像她那样的服务态度，让我觉得很满意。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge zhuānguì de xiǎojiě zhēn tǐtiē, búdàn yòng piàoliàng de zhǐ bǎ yīfu bāo qǐlái, hái hěn xiǎoxīn de fàng jìn dàizi lǐ. Xiàng tā nàyàng de fúwù tàidù, ràng wǒ juéde hěn mǎnyì.
text.english: The sales assistant at this counter is so thoughtful; she not only wrapped the clothes in nice paper, but also put them carefully into the bag. Service like hers makes me feel very satisfied.

text.traditional: 這就是「貨比三家不吃虧」的道理啊！還好我們看了三家，又比了比價錢、品質，要不然恐怕花了錢還不開心呢！
text.simplified: 这就是「货比三家不吃亏」的道理啊！还好我们看了三家，又比了比价钱、品质，要不然恐怕花了钱还不开心呢！
text.pinyin: Zhè jiù shì “huòbǐsānjiā bù chīkuī” de dàolǐ a! Háihǎo wǒmen kàn le sān jiā, yòu bǐ le bǐ jiàqián, pǐnzhí, yàobùrán kǒngpà huā le qián hái bù kāixīn ne!
text.english: That's the logic of "shopping around won't hurt"! Luckily we visited three counters and compared the price and quality, otherwise we might have spent money and ended up unhappy!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say not only one thing but also another, mostly in writing, with 不僅……，還/也/而且…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「不僅」當連接詞，有「不但」的意思，多用在書面，後面的分句句首用「還、也、而且」。

patternTable.title: Conjunction 不僅 (Not Only ..., But Also)

text.traditional: 購物時要多看幾家店，不僅要比一比價格，還要比一比品質。
text.simplified: 购物时要多看几家店，不仅要比一比价格，还要比一比品质。
text.pinyin: Gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, bù jǐn yào bǐ yì bǐ jiàgé, hái yào bǐ yì bǐ pǐnzhí.
text.english: When you go shopping, you should look around at several stores, not only to compare prices but also to compare quality.

text.traditional: 謝先生不僅性格開朗，工作也很認真、負責，所以同事都很喜歡他。
text.simplified: 谢先生不仅性格开朗，工作也很认真、负责，所以同事都很喜欢他。
text.pinyin: Xiè xiānshēng bù jǐn xìnggé kāilǎng, gōngzuò yě hěn rènzhēn, fùzé, suǒyǐ tóngshì dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
text.english: Mr. Xie not only has a cheerful personality but is also very hardworking and responsible at work, so all his colleagues like him.

text.traditional: 照華人的傳統，除夕當天不僅要打掃、貼春聯，而且家人要在一起吃年夜飯。
text.simplified: 照华人的传统，除夕当天不仅要打扫、贴春联，而且家人要在一起吃年夜饭。
text.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng, chúxī dāngtiān bù jǐn yào dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, érqiě jiārén yào zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
text.english: According to Chinese tradition, on Lunar New Year's Eve you not only have to clean the house and put up spring couplets, but the family also has to get together for New Year's Eve dinner.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 不僅……也/還…… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 不僅 is used as a conjunction connective, which means the same as 不但. It is mostly used in writing. The beginning of the following clauses starts with 還, 也, 而且.

grammarPages.titleTraditional: NP 一 M 比一 M + Vs（了）
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Each One More … Than the Last
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say something keeps getting hotter, better or worse, day by day or one after another, with 一M比一M + adjective (天氣一天比一天熱了).
grammarPages.explanation: 說明事物或情況的程度逐漸變化。例如：天氣一天比一天熱了。
grammarPages.pattern: Topic + 一 + Measure word + 比 + 一 + Measure word + Adjective (+ 了)

text.traditional: 那裡的商品常常是一樣比一樣便宜。
text.simplified: 那里的商品常常是一样比一样便宜。
text.pinyin: Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng bǐ yí yàng piányí.
text.english: There, each item is often cheaper than the last.

text.traditional: 這個學期王小明很用功，考試的成績也一次比一次進步了。
text.simplified: 这个学期王小明很用功，考试的成绩也一次比一次进步了。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí Wáng Xiǎomíng hěn yònggōng, kǎoshì de chéngjī yě yí cì bǐ yí cì jìnbù le.
text.english: Wang Xiaoming has been working hard this semester, and his test scores have gotten better each time.

text.traditional: 這個地區因為工廠越來越多的關係，空氣一年比一年差了。
text.simplified: 这个地区因为工厂越来越多的关系，空气一年比一年差了。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū yīnwèi gōngchǎng yuè lái yuè duō de guānxì, kōngqì yì nián bǐ yì nián chà le.
text.english: Because there are more and more factories in this area, the air has gotten worse year after year.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using NP 一M比一M + Vs (了) in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This sentence structure explains that the degree of a thing or situation changes gradually. For example, 天氣一天比一天熱了。

dialogue.title: 短文 · 比價 · Comparing Prices
grammarFocus: NP 一 M 比一 M + Vs（了）

text.traditional: 華人常說「貨比三家不吃虧」，意思是購物時要多看幾家店，不僅要比一比價格，還要比一比品質。這樣才能買得開心、用得放心。
text.simplified: 华人常说「货比三家不吃亏」，意思是购物时要多看几家店，不仅要比一比价格，还要比一比品质。这样才能买得开心、用得放心。
text.pinyin: Huárén cháng shuō “huòbǐsānjiā bù chīkuī”, yìsi shì gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, bù jǐn yào bǐ yì bǐ jiàgé, hái yào bǐ yì bǐ pǐnzhí. Zhèyàng cái néng mǎi de kāixīn, yòng de fàngxīn.
text.english: Chinese people often say "compare prices at three stores so you won't suffer a loss," meaning that when shopping one should check out several shops, comparing not only prices but also quality. Only in this way can one buy happily and use with peace of mind.

text.traditional: 在臺灣，只要一提到買便宜的東西，大家就會想到夜市或地攤。那裡的商品常常是一樣比一樣便宜。攤販都努力地向客人推銷，希望客人把錢從口袋裡拿出來、把商品都帶走。不過有的客人非常聰明，完全沒忘記品質和價格一樣重要，不管攤販在他們面前說什麼，都不會糊里糊塗地亂買。他們會把每個攤子都看一看、找一找，想辦法買到實在又優惠的商品。
text.simplified: 在台湾，只要一提到买便宜的东西，大家就会想到夜市或地摊。那里的商品常常是一样比一样便宜。摊贩都努力地向客人推销，希望客人把钱从口袋里拿出来、把商品都带走。不过有的客人非常聪明，完全没忘记品质和价格一样重要，不管摊贩在他们面前说什么，都不会糊里糊涂地乱买。他们会把每个摊子都看一看、找一找，想办法买到实在又优惠的商品。
text.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, zhǐyào yì tídào mǎi piányí de dōngxi, dàjiā jiù huì xiǎngdào yèshì huò dìtān. Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng bǐ yí yàng piányí. Tānfàn dōu nǔlì de xiàng kèrén tuīxiāo, xīwàng kèrén bǎ qián cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū lái, bǎ shāngpǐn dōu dài zǒu. Búguò yǒude kèrén fēicháng cōngmíng, wánquán méi wàngjì pǐnzhí hàn jiàgé yíyàng zhòngyào, bùguǎn tānfàn zài tāmen miànqián shuō shénme, dōu bú huì húlǐhútú de luàn mǎi. Tāmen huì bǎ měi ge tānzi dōu kàn yí kàn, zhǎo yì zhǎo, xiǎng bànfǎ mǎi dào shízài yòu yōuhuì de shāngpǐn.
text.english: In Taiwan, whenever buying cheap things is mentioned, everyone thinks of night markets or street stalls. There, each item is often cheaper than the last. Vendors strive to pitch to customers, hoping they will take money out of their pockets and take merchandise away. However, some customers are very smart and never forget that quality is as important as price; no matter what vendors say to them, they never buy blindly or foolishly. They inspect and search every stall to figure out how to purchase solid and discounted goods.

text.traditional: 以購物習慣來說，一般人除了去商店、超市買東西，網路購物也早就流行了。網路商店提供各式各樣的商品，從碗筷、雨傘、行李箱等生活用品，到電腦、廚房、露營等的設備都找得到，也看得到價格和生產地區，所以網路購物能幫我們節省不少比價和交通的時間。
text.simplified: 以购物习惯来说，一般人除了去商店、超市买东西，网路购物也早就流行了。网路商店提供各式各样的商品，从碗筷、雨伞、行李箱等生活用品，到电脑、厨房、露营等的设备都找得到，也看得到价格和生产地区，所以网路购物能帮我们节省不少比价和交通的时间。
text.pinyin: Yǐ gòuwù xíguàn lái shuō, yìbānrén chúle qù shāngdiàn, chāoshì mǎi dōngxi, wǎnglù gòuwù yě zǎojiù liúxíng le. Wǎnglù shāngdiàn tígōng gèshìgèyàng de shāngpǐn, cóng wǎn kuài, yǔsǎn, xínglǐxiāng děng shēnghuó yòngpǐn, dào diànnǎo, chúfáng, lùyíng děng de shèbèi dōu zhǎo de dào, yě kàn de dào jiàgé hàn shēngchǎn dìqū, suǒyǐ wǎnglù gòuwù néng bāng wǒmen jiéshěng bùshǎo bǐjià hàn jiāotōng de shíjiān.
text.english: In terms of shopping habits, besides going to stores and supermarkets, most people have long been shopping online too. Online stores offer all kinds of goods: from daily necessities like bowls, chopsticks, umbrellas, and luggage, to equipment for computers, kitchens, and camping. Prices and places of manufacture can all be checked, so online shopping saves us a lot of time on price comparison and commuting.

text.traditional: 其實不管採用哪一種購物方式，都有它的優點和缺點。只有想清楚自己到底需要什麼，仔細地讀商品說明，認真地比價格、比品質，這樣才是聰明顧客的最佳選擇。就算眼光很高的人，也保證能夠買到滿意的商品。
text.simplified: 其实不管采用哪一种购物方式，都有它的优点和缺点。只有想清楚自己到底需要什么，仔细地读商品说明，认真地比价格、比品质，这样才是聪明顾客的最佳选择。就算眼光很高的人，也保证能够买到满意的商品。
text.pinyin: Qíshí bùguǎn cǎiyòng nǎ yì zhǒng gòuwù fāngshì, dōu yǒu tā de yōudiǎn hàn quēdiǎn. Zhǐyǒu xiǎng qīngchǔ zìjǐ dàodǐ xūyào shénme, zǐxì de dú shāngpǐn shuōmíng, rènzhēn de bǐ jiàgé, bǐ pǐnzhí, zhèyàng cái shì cōngmíng gùkè de zuìjiā xuǎnzé. Jiùsuàn yǎnguāng hěn gāo de rén, yě bǎozhèng nénggòu mǎi dào mǎnyì de shāngpǐn.
text.english: In reality, no matter which shopping method one adopts, each has its advantages and disadvantages.
